VREG_AND_CHIP_RESET: CHIP_RESET Register
Offset: 0x8
Description
Chip reset control and status
Table 191.
CHIP_RESET Register

Bits

Description

Type

Reset

31:25

Reserved.

-

-

24

PSM_RESTART_FLAG: This is set by psm_restart from the debugger.

WC

0x0

Its purpose is to branch bootcode to a safe mode when the debugger has
issued a psm_restart in order to recover from a boot lock-up.
In the safe mode the debugger can repair the boot code, clear this flag then
reboot the processor.
